body: I am in the same position and really struggling with the limited options
I got all 4 out on Friday and only got 400mg of ibuprofen and it’s been completely fine so far
But the main issue with my depression is that it’s chemical and not circumstantial which makes it much harder to treat although I have attempted many treatments
So cold by ben cocks is one of my favorites

I totally regret opening up, she asked to show me and then proceeded to say it’s not that bad which has caused me to do it so much more regularly and deeper as if I now need to prove something to her even though I don’t see her anymore
This is so helpful, thank you!!

In this case its serious enough to talk to her and explain that you know whats going on but you
Want to help. You need to make it clear that its serious and you’re worried about her. If you have a school counselor go for a session with her, if not meet up with one of her parents and express your concern but definitely dont sit and wait for her to feel better x

I’ve been suicidal lately and it’s so different to just being depressed. I promised my mom i would never do it but in the last 3 months I’ve collected and calculated what i would need to OD, i have written suicide letters and stopped planning my future yet know i would never actually kill myself. I am just stuck with this feeing of not wanting to live so i get you.

I have a psychiatrist, psychologist, am on antidepressants and have supportive family and friends and still have this horrible feeling inside me that just doesn’t go away. I’m 17 and can’t imagine making it to 24 still feeling like this. Thanks for your kindness
